general.tagline: Rejuvenate Your Body & Mind at Your Villa
general.description: Premium on-call massage and spa treatments delivered directly to your villa, hotel, or home in Bali. Certified therapists, organic oils, and pure relaxation.

services.title: Balinese Traditional Massage
services.description: A full-body, deep-tissue, holistic treatment that uses a combination of gentle stretches, acupressure, reflexology, and aromatherapy.

services.title: Deep Tissue Massage
services.description: Focuses on realigning deeper layers of muscles. Beneficial for chronic aches and pains and contracted areas.

services.title: Foot Reflexology
services.description: Applies pressure to specific points on the feet to restore natural energy flow and improve circulation.

faqs.question: How do I book a massage?
faqs.answer: Simply select your service on our website, click 'Book on WhatsApp', fill in your details (date, time, villa/hotel address), and our admin will confirm your booking instantly.

faqs.question: Are there any transport fees?
faqs.answer: No, all transport costs are included in the menu price for our service coverage areas.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept Cash (IDR) directly to the therapist, Bank Transfers, or Wise payments.
